messages: maria: Quick heads up — migration guide PR needs to land before the 1.8 docs cutoff tomorrow. CI preview is failing on linkcheck, blocking merge. Can we triage? sam: saw the CI fail, will paste log in a sec. looks like missing anchor in migration/upgrade.md -> 'remove-deprecated-config' docs-ci-bot: docs-preview build failed on branch fix/upgrade-anchor: linkcheck error: ERROR: docs/migration/upgrade.md: anchor 'remove-deprecated-config' not found anya: I can review once the failing link is fixed. @kevin-docs can you please be on standby to approve? kevin-docs: Yep I can do a quick review. Question: is this a doc-only fix or does it depend on the code rollout/feature flag? maria: Release PM says the feature flag (ff/upgrade-1-8) flips at 18:00 PT. Docs cutoff for code-dependent changes is 16:00 PT. If this anchor references code not in prod, we should avoid landing a doc that points to non-existent runtime behavior. sam: the anchor points at a section that will exist once the FF ships. For now anchor is missing because the code-side headings changed in the branch. We can either: 1) Add a temporary redirect anchor in docs to keep linkcheck happy and update later, or 2) Hold the PR until the FF is live and merge after 18:00 PT. devex-ryan: I'll put up a tiny PR that adds the redirect anchor + a TODO comment referencing the code PR. This is doc-only and low-risk. We should mark it so release knows it's reversible. maria: prefer not to block the release engineer. If it's truly reversible, go ahead with redirect now. Please add label `do-not-revert-until-verified:false` (jk) — seriously, add `docs/temporary-anchor` and a short note in the PR description. I'll notify release channel. sam: pushing fix now. small snippet I added: ```html ``` docs-ci-bot: build started for branch fix/upgrade-anchor docs-ci-bot: build succeeded: preview available at https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/branch/fix/upgrade-anchor kevin-docs: Reviewing the PR: LGTM aside from one nit about wording. Approving now. sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2023 — labels: docs/temporary-anchor, docs/merge-schedule/morning-cutoff devex-ryan: scheduling merge at 15:45 PT to give the release engineer time to validate downstream. Ping me in #release when you're ready @maria. release-bot: Merge scheduled for PR #2023 at 2024-03-15T15:45:00-07:00 — will attempt auto-merge when CI green and no blockers present. maria: Thanks — I'll message release-eng to expect this. After the FF flips at 18:00 PT we'll follow up to remove the temporary anchor and clean up the note. kevin-docs: :thumbsup: small, clear change. Approved. sam: merged at 15:45 PT, CI green. devex-ryan: noted — I'll open a quick follow-up task to revert the anchor once we confirm ff/upgrade-1-8 is live. maria: perfect, thanks everyone :rocket:
